name: Domain Verification + Engagement Proof Hardening + Full Dataset Reverify
description: Fix the false-positive verification pipeline (MS bot opens counted as human proof, wrong company domains stored, bounces never polled), then scrub and reverify EVERY company already mined in lead-finder: confirm the real email domain via Google Places + MX + published emails, store only proven patterns, and gate test sends to the lowest-ranked employee per AOM rules. All progress tracked per LEAD_FINDER_DISCOVERY_SOP.md (the project AOM; ~/ls-shared-dev/agent-guides/AOM.md does not exist).

evidence: Official site https://www.arrowheadproducts.net/ (aerospace ducting, Los Alamitos CA, since 1937)
Published emails on contact page: mro@arrowheadproducts.net, mil@arrowheadproducts.net
MX arrowheadproducts.com -> mail.messaging.microsoft.com (different entity; mailboxes rejected)
false_positive_chain: Wrong .com domain stored -> derived emails rejected by MX
Microsoft OneOutlook/SafeLinks link-preview bot hit the tracking pixel (UA OneOutlook/1.2026.728.100, MS IPv6 range)
track_server.py records every pixel hit as an open with zero bot filtering
engagement_verify.py treats any opened_at as 'Okay to Send' proof and promotes company pattern
poll_graph_delivery.py never recorded the NDRs (bounce_status/delivery_status NULL, last_poll_at NULL)

context.aom_note: User referenced ~/home/ls-shared-dev/agent-guides/AOM.md; that path does not exist. The project AOM is LEAD_FINDER_DISCOVERY_SOP.md (v1.0, 2026-07-06). All progress tracking follows its Phase A-F SOP, Phase D verification, Phase E quality gates G.1-G.5, and Phase F diagnostics.

phases.label: Phase 0 — Harden the verification pipeline (fix false positives)
gates: MS bot opens (OneOutlook, SafeLinks, Outlook link-preview, curl, known bot UAs/IPs) are never counted as human proof
Bounce/delivery polling records NDRs so bounces override opens
Engagement check requires human open OR Graph delivery confirmation before marking Okay to Send
No pattern is promoted to engagement_proven on bot-only evidence

tasks.title: Bot filtering in track_server.py pixel endpoint: classify UA + IP; block OneOutlook/SafeLinks/link-preview/curl/known bot ranges; record open_type (human|bot) in track.db
Add open_type column to track_db.py sends schema (migration via _add_column_if_missing pattern)
engagement_verify.py check_results: require human open (open_type=human) OR bounce_status=delivered; bot-only opens stay pending
engagement_verify.py _promote_company_pattern: never promote on bot open; require human open + >=1 open_count
Fix poll_graph_delivery.py: verify it runs for hub lead-finder-verify, matches NDRs by internetMessageId, writes bounce_status/bounce_detail/delivery_status
Backup core files (.bak-pre-domain-hardening-<ts>) before edits; py_compile + regression_check + pytest after

phases.label: Phase 1 — Google Places domain verification (source of truth for email domain)
gates: Every company's email domain is confirmed via Google Places websiteUri + MX + published emails before any pattern work
Aggregator/3rd-party domains rejected (AGGREGATOR_DOMAINS)
Domain mismatch (stored website vs confirmed domain) logged and corrected
No pattern stored for a company whose domain cannot be confirmed

tasks.title: Implement verify_company_domain(company_id) in lf_search.py: Places Text Search '"<name>" <city> <state> manufacturing' (or business_type disambiguation), extract websiteUri, normalize to bare domain
Cross-check confirmed domain: MX lookup (dnspython), fetch homepage, search for published '@domain' emails; require >=1 corroboration
Add companies columns: email_domain_confirmed, email_domain_source, email_domain_checked_at, email_domain_evidence (JSON), email_domain_mismatch (bool)
Update companies.website to confirmed domain when mismatch found (log old value)
Wire domain verification into _infer_pattern_v2 and derive_emails_for_company so patterns only use confirmed domains
Backup lf.db before any domain corrections (.bak-pre-domain-verify-<ts>.db)

phases.label: Phase 2 — Scrub and reverify ALL mined companies
gates: Every company in lf.db has a confirmed domain OR a logged unconfirmed reason
Every contact with email_ready_for_export=1 has real proof (human open, Graph delivery, or SMTP 250 on confirmed domain)
All bot-open-derived 'Okay to Send' statuses reset to unvalidated
All engagement_proven companies re-verified against confirmed domains

tasks.title: Inventory: list all companies with contacts, their stored website/domain, pattern, proof status, and contact validation states
Reset false positives: contacts whose only proof was a bot open (open_type=bot) -> smtp_validation_status=NULL, email_ready_for_export=0, validation_method=NULL
Reset engagement_proven companies (603 Arrowhead, 641 Cosmetic Group USA) to unproven; clear pattern until domain re-verified
Run verify_company_domain for every company with contacts; correct website/domain where mismatch
Re-derive candidate emails on confirmed domains for contacts at each company
Re-run SMTP proof gate (check_email_pattern_proof) on confirmed domains; store only proven patterns
For companies where SMTP proof is impossible (hard-reject/catch-all), queue engagement test sends to the LOWEST-RANKED employee per AOM rules (cornerstone selection: lowest title rank, not C-suite)
Write per-company diagnostics to discovery_job_items / a new domain_verify_jobs table (Phase F compliance)

phases.label: Phase 3 — Engagement reverify with hardened proof
gates: Test sends go only to lowest-ranked employees at companies where SMTP proof is impossible
Only human opens (open_type=human) or Graph delivery confirmations count as proof
Bounces recorded and override opens
Wait up to 72 hours before final classification

tasks.title: Queue generation: top 2-4 candidate emails per contact on confirmed domain, hub=lead-finder-verify, unique token per candidate
tasks.note: Requires explicit user approval before any send. Not executed in this session because the human approval gate is mandatory per change_control.no_send_without_approval.

tasks.title: Human approval gate: user reviews recipient list + message body before any send (no sends without explicit approval)
Send via lead-seeker live_solutions_outreach.py from anthony@livesolutionsnow.com (LS_FROM_ADDR)
Poll track.db after 24-72h: classify human-open/delivered as Okay to Send, bounced as Do Not Send, bot-only as pending
Write results back to contacts + companies (pattern promotion only on human proof)

phases.label: Phase 4 — Final audit and compliance
gates: regression_check.py OK, py_compile clean, pytest 5 passed
AOM compliance checklist (Section 7) verified
Final dataset state documented: companies confirmed/unconfirmed, contacts by validation status, export-ready count
All progress logged per AOM Phase F

tasks.result: py_compile clean, pytest 9 passed, regression_check OK

tasks.title: Verify AOM Section 7 compliance checklist

Email patterns inferred only from confirmed domains. Diagnostics stored in discovery_jobs/domain-verify-20260812-230000 + discovery_job_items. No global unscoped backfill used.

tasks.title: Write final report: domain verification results, pattern proof results, engagement results, remaining unverified
tasks.result: Final state: 73 companies with contacts; 42 confirmed domains, 31 unconfirmed; 14 proven patterns, 28 unproven patterns; 9 contacts ready for export; 1 contact reset after bot/engagement proof. Engagement reverify (Phase 3) pending explicit user approval per no_send_without_approval.
